sources.location: https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.105541 (Europe PMC PMC12656530, full text read)

claims.evidence: Paper: U2OS Flp-In T-REx cells expressing SYTL5-EGFP (doxycycline-induced 24 h) or EGFP; Cellosaurus U2OS.
Cellosaurus values for U2OS, not stated in the paper.

claims.value: SYTL5-EGFP (IP2, IP4, IP6) vs EGFP (IP1, IP3, IP5)
claims.evidence: Paper: SYTL5-EGFP vs EGFP control IP, 3 biological replicates. Run assignment derived from deposited proteinGroups intensity: SYTL5 ~2.7e7-5.3e7 in IP2/4/6 vs <3.3e4 in IP1/3/5.
Deposited mqpar_2.xml and summary.txt (Trypsin/P); protocol says trypsin without proline restriction.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M and Acetyl Protein N-term variable

claims.evidence: mqpar_2.xml mainSearchTol 10 and TOF MatchTolerance 40 (protocol text says 6 ppm main search; deposited parameter file used).
Run names from mqpar_2.xml and proteinGroups columns; the deposit contains only LCMS_files.zip (11.5 GB) containing these runs.

limitations: The deposited raw data is a single archive LCMS_files.zip; contents not unpacked or listed. Six .d run names were taken from the deposited MaxQuant mqpar_2.xml/proteinGroups and claimed in place of the zip.

Run-to-condition mapping (which IP is SYTL5-EGFP vs EGFP) is not in any metadata; it was inferred from bait (SYTL5) protein intensities in the deposited proteinGroups. IP2/4/6 = SYTL5-EGFP, IP1/3/5 = EGFP.
Biological replicate numbers 1-3 within each group follow run order (IP1/IP2 = 1, IP3/IP4 = 2, IP5/IP6 = 3); pairing is an assumption, not documented.

Age 15Y and sex female are Cellosaurus values for U2OS, not sample-specific. Cell line is U2OS Flp-In T-REx per the paper; annotated as parent U2OS (CVCL_0042), the engineered derivative not separately resolved.
Dissociation method, MS2 analyzer, reduction and alkylation reagents are not stated explicitly: not available. Organism part and cell type not available (osteosarcoma line; no CL/BTO term assigned).
Doxycycline induction (100 ng/ml, 24 h) applies to all samples and is not annotated as a treatment column. characteristics[transgene] is a non-template extra column.
Protocol text states 6 ppm main search error while deposited mqpar_2.xml has 10 ppm; the file value was used.

SANDBOX ONLY (independent review FAIL): row 6 names 'Ana IP 6 repeated_Slot1-24_1_247.d', the run searched in mqpar_2.xml/proteinGroups, but the deposited zip (283 entries, central directory read) contains instead 'IP6 Ana_Slot1-24_1_227.d' (not searched); the _247 repeat is NOT deposited. The report's earlier statement that the original IP6 is not deposited is wrong. Row 6 data file and its SYTL5-EGFP identity are therefore unresolved. Rows 1-5 (_217 to _225) were confirmed present in the zip.
